trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: State the context of the outbound call and ask to verify the phone number for security.
steps.text: வணக்கம், நான் உங்கள் telecom operator-ல் இருந்து பேசுகிறேன். உங்கள் prepaid plan validity நாளை முடிவடைகிறது. Security-க்காக உங்கள் phone number மற்றும் date of birth சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Confirm the number, volunteer date of birth, and express confusion about the expiry.
steps.text: இது MSN-1009. என் பேரு Ramesh, date of birth 12th May 1985. Validity எப்படி நாளை முடியும்? நான் போன மாசம் தான் recharge பண்ணேன்.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the volunteered MSISDN and date of birth.
Return the verification outcome.
Look up the subscriber's current plan and balance before recommending a recharge.
Return the current plan, validity, and data balance.
Inform the customer of their current plan, expiring validity, and low data balance.
steps.text: Ramesh, உங்கள் details verify ஆகிவிட்டது. நீங்கள் இப்போ P199 plan-ல் இருக்கிறீர்கள். உங்கள் validity 1 நாள்-ல் முடியும். Data 0.2 GB தான் மீதம் இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Express surprise at the low data and request a new plan with at least 1.5 GB data.
steps.text: Oh, 0.2 GB தான் இருக்கா? சரி, எனக்கு ஒரு நல்ல plan சொல்லுங்க. எனக்கு minimum 1.5 GB data வேணும்.
steps.clean_text: Oh, 0.2 GB தான் இருக்கா? சரி, எனக்கு ஒரு நல்ல plan சொல்லுங்க. எனக்கு minimum 1.5 GB data வேணும்.
steps.model_visible_text: Oh, 0.2 GB தான் இருக்கா? சரி, எனக்கு ஒரு நல்ல plan சொல்லுங்க. எனக்கு minimum 1.8 GB data வேணும்.

steps.purpose: Clarify the misheard data requirement.
steps.text: 1.8 GB data தேவையா? Telecom plans-ல் 1.5 GB அல்லது 2 GB தான் இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Confirm the desired data amount is 1.5 GB.
List available plans with at least 1.5 GB data.
Return the available 1.5 GB plan.
Offer the P249 plan details to the customer.
steps.text: P249 plan இருக்கு. இதன் price 249 rupees, 28 days validity, தினமும் 1.5 GB data கிடைக்கும்.

steps.purpose: Reject the 1.5 GB plan and ask for a 2 GB data plan instead.
steps.text: 1.5 GB பத்தாது, எனக்கு 2 GB data plan இருக்கா னு சொல்லுங்க.
steps.clean_text: 1.5 GB பத்தாது, எனக்கு 2 GB data plan இருக்கா னு சொல்லுங்க.
steps.model_visible_text: 1.5 GB பத்தாது, எனக்கு 2 GB data plan இருக்கானு சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: List available plans with at least 2 GB data.
Return the available 2 GB plan.
Offer the P299 plan details to the customer.
steps.text: 2 GB data-வுக்கு P299 plan இருக்கு. Price 299 rupees, 28 days validity கிடைக்கும்.

steps.purpose: Agree to the plan but ask a clarifying question about when it becomes active.
steps.text: சரி, எனக்கு P299 plan recharge பண்ணிடுங்க. இது எப்போ active ஆகும்?
steps.clean_text: சரி, எனக்கு P299 plan recharge பண்ணிடுங்க. இது எப்போ active ஆகும்?
steps.model_visible_text: சரி, எனக்கு P299 plan recharge பண்ணிடுங்க. இது எப்போ active ஆகும்?

steps.purpose: Answer the clarifying question and ask for final confirmation to apply the recharge.
steps.text: இது உடனே active ஆகும். நான் இப்போவே recharge apply பண்ணட்டுமா?

steps.purpose: Give final confirmation and restate the plan figures for reassurance.
steps.text: சரி, 299 rupees plan recharge பண்ணிடுங்க. 28 days validity கிடைக்கும் தானே?
steps.clean_text: சரி, 299 rupees plan recharge பண்ணிடுங்க. 28 days validity கிடைக்கும் தானே?
steps.model_visible_text: சரி, 299 rupees plan recharge பண்ணிடுங்க. 28 days validity கிடைக்கும் தானே?

steps.purpose: Apply the chosen recharge plan for the customer.
Return the successful recharge transaction details.
Confirm the successful recharge and provide the transaction ID.
steps.text: உங்கள் recharge success ஆகிவிட்டது. Transaction id TXN-9876. P299 plan உடனே active ஆகிவிட்டது.

ir.terminal_condition: Recharge or migration applied with a transaction id and the effective date stated.
